summary: Husbands culpability in wifes death; homicide vs suicide; absence of hyoid bone rupture; alibi claim re: Maitri Garden; dupatta used as ligature tied to ceiling fan; no self-inflicted injuries; witness testimony of sister PW-8; inconsistent timing of cutting noose; lifesaving attempt implausible; Section 106 Evidence Act presumption applied; circumstantial evidence cumulatively conclusive; impugned conviction under Sections 302 201 498A IPC for dowry death upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence confirmed; life imprisonment for murder maintained.
